tools.name: query_nk_demo_state
tools.title: Query Buttercup NK demo state
tools.description: READ-ONLY status check for the Splunk4Rookies Eventgen storyline. Returns infrastructure (NK attack stanza off, default) or threat (NK purchase-attack traffic on). Never changes configuration.

tools.name: apply_nk_demo_state
tools.title: Apply Buttercup NK demo state change
tools.description: WRITE action: enable or disable the Eventgen North Korea purchase-attack stanza. Use only when the user explicitly asks to start or stop the NK attack demo. Argument mode=infrastructure turns NK off; mode=threat turns NK on.

mode.description: infrastructure = disable NK attack stanza; threat = enable NK geo attack on failed purchases

examples.name: Start NK attack simulation
examples.description: Enable North Korean purchase-attack Eventgen traffic
examples.expected_use: User asks to start the NK attack storyline for the demo

examples.name: Return to infrastructure mode
examples.expected_use: User asks to stop the threat simulation

tools.name: validate_nk_attack_traffic
tools.title: Validate North Korea attack traffic
tools.description: READ-ONLY workshop check backed by saved search S4R Validate NK Attack Traffic. Returns failed purchases from North Korea or 175.45.* client IPs (default last 15m). Empty results mean no NK geo signal yet — confirm threat mode with query_nk_demo_state.

examples.name: Confirm NK attack data is flowing
examples.description: After enabling threat mode, verify Pyongyang / 175.45.* failed purchases appear
examples.expected_use: User enabled NK simulation and wants to confirm Eventgen traffic is visible in Search

tools.name: geo_failed_purchases
tools.title: Geo failed purchase hotspots
tools.description: READ-ONLY Security & Fraud panel backed by saved search S4R Geo Failed Purchase Hotspots. Returns top failed-purchase geo hotspots (Country, City, clientip) and top cities by overall web activity (default last 24h). In threat mode expect North Korea / Pyongyang and 175.45.* IPs to dominate hotspots; use validate_nk_attack_traffic for a focused NK check (last 15m).

examples.name: Where are failed purchases concentrated?
examples.description: Geo hotspots for checkout failures and top cities by volume
examples.expected_use: User asks about geographic fraud indicators or failed-purchase concentration

tools.name: summarize_purchase_health
tools.title: Summarize Buttercup purchase health
tools.description: READ-ONLY Business Analytics KPIs backed by saved search S4R Summarize Purchase Health. Returns lost revenue (product_codes lookup), success vs failure purchase counts, and top products by lost revenue (default last 24h). Use for questions like whether the site is losing money from failed checkouts.

examples.name: Checkout revenue at risk
examples.description: Total lost revenue and failed purchase volume
examples.expected_use: User asks if the website is losing money or how much failed checkout costs
